consistency_note: The 10 class names below are the single source of truth. They MUST be identical in config/classes.json, the Python model's label encoder, the Google Teachable Machine project's class labels, the app's UI and the alert rules. Duplicating or paraphrasing a class name anywhere breaks the model comparison.

criteria.critical: Requires >= 85% recall on the untouched test split (SRS NFR). A missed detection here is a safety failure, so recall is prioritised over precision.

classes.name: Machinery Fault
classes.description: Abnormal mechanical operation: grinding, squealing bearing, rhythmic knocking, metal-on-metal friction.

classes.name: Glass Breaking
classes.description: Sharp broadband transient with high-frequency shards and a short decay tail.

classes.name: Alarm or Siren
classes.description: Sustained tonal alert: smoke alarm, security siren, industrial alarm, vehicle siren.

classes.name: Vehicle Horn
classes.description: Short tonal blast from a car or truck horn; often harmonically rich with 1-2 dominant tones.

classes.name: Gunshot
classes.description: Extremely sharp impulse with near-instant attack and a broadband muzzle blast; may include an echo tail.

classes.name: Panic Scream
classes.description: High-pitched sustained human vocalisation under distress; high pitch variance, elevated energy above 1 kHz.

classes.name: Aggression
classes.description: Angry shouting, threatening vocal tone, aggressive non-speech vocalisation.

classes.name: Person Asking for Help
classes.description: Restricted to the SRS-permitted safety phrases only: 'Help me', 'Somebody help', 'Please help', 'Call for help', 'Emergency'.

classes.name: Background Noise
classes.description: Neutral ambient audio with no target event: traffic hum, room tone, crowd murmur, wind, HVAC.
